title: Mexico's cultural participation is broad but sharply stratified by age, education, disability, and Indigenous-language status
source_unit: INEGI MODECULT 2025 Module on Selected Cultural Events
geography: Mexico; national population aged 12 years and above, with urban comparison for selected events

observations.period: 2025 MODECULT; national cultural-event attendance in the preceding 12 months

denominator.unit: population aged 12 years and above in Mexico; the press release does not state the respondent count

any_cultural_event.unit: percent attending at least one cultural event in the previous 12 months

women_any_event.unit: percent of women attending at least one cultural event

men_any_event.unit: percent of men attending at least one cultural event

disability_any_event.unit: percent of people with a disability attending at least one cultural event

indigenous_language_any_event.unit: percent of Indigenous-language speakers attending at least one cultural event

mechanism.value: Broad national attendance coexists with a large access gap for disability and Indigenous-language groups, while the overall gender gap is small

observations.method: INEGI MODECULT 2025 national estimates for people aged 12 and above; the 2025 instrument expanded beyond the prior urban 18+ design and added event categories.
observations.uncertainty: The source does not establish whether the gaps arise from cost, transport, accessibility, language, supply, invitation, safety, or different event preferences; the 2025 methodological expansion limits direct comparison with earlier waves.
observations.subgroup: Women, men, people with disabilities, and Indigenous-language speakers aged 12 years and above.
observations.counterinterpretation: The disability and Indigenous-language differences may reflect age, geography, income, or event measurement rather than a single exclusion mechanism; broad attendance includes diverse event types.

denominator.unit: population aged 12 years and above in Mexico; subgroup denominators are not separately disclosed in the press release

age_12_24.unit: percent of people aged 12-24 attending at least one cultural event

age_50_plus.unit: percent of people aged 50 and above attending at least one cultural event

basic_education_incomplete.unit: percent of people with incomplete basic education attending at least one cultural event

higher_education.unit: percent of people with some higher education attending at least one cultural event

mechanism.value: Cultural access follows life-course and education gradients much more strongly than the aggregate attendance rate suggests

observations.method: INEGI MODECULT 2025 descriptive subgroup estimates for age and educational attainment.
observations.uncertainty: These are descriptive differences and do not identify whether education causes attendance, whether age reflects life-cycle or cohort effects, or how cost and location mediate the relationship.
observations.subgroup: People aged 12-24 versus 50+, and people with incomplete basic education versus some higher education.
observations.counterinterpretation: Younger and more educated groups may have greater exposure through schools, cities, work networks, or measurement opportunities rather than inherently stronger cultural motivation.

observations.period: 2025 MODECULT; event mix and active artistic practice

denominator.unit: Event attendees for event mix; artistic participants aged 12+ for artistic activity mix. Subgroup counts not disclosed.

fair_attendance_among_attendees.unit: percent of cultural-event attendees who attended fairs, including artisan, food, or local-product fairs

cinema_among_attendees.unit: percent of cultural-event attendees who attended a film screening or cinema

audiovisual_creation.unit: percent participating in photography, video, or another audiovisual creation activity among people aged 12+ who reported artistic activities

creative_handwork.unit: percent doing manual work for artistic or creative purposes among people aged 12+ who reported artistic activities

drawing_painting_sculpture.unit: percent drawing, painting, or making sculpture among people aged 12+ who reported artistic activities

mechanism.value: Cultural participation includes local fairs and everyday creation, not only formal institutions; production and attendance are both important routes into cultural life

observations.method: INEGI MODECULT 2025 conditional event and artistic-activity distributions; the results presentation page 23 explicitly restricts artistic activity shares to people who performed artistic activities.
observations.uncertainty: The press release does not provide frequency, spending, online distribution, quality, or whether audiovisual creation is recreational, educational, professional, or social-media oriented.
observations.subgroup: Cultural-event attendees for event mix; people aged 12+ reporting artistic activities for creative practice.
observations.counterinterpretation: The broad creation categories may include occasional low-intensity activity and should not be interpreted as professional cultural production or durable creator identity.

related_sources.claim: INEGI methodology page documents the 2025 expansion from urban adults to national population aged 12 and above, added event categories, and revised variables.
Official MODECULT 2025 press release and tables provide the attendance, subgroup, event-mix, and active-practice estimates.
Page 23 explicitly identifies the conditional artistic-participant universe.

boundary: This record adds Mexican cultural-participation evidence with explicit disability, Indigenous-language, age, education, event-type, and active-creation gradients. It does not identify causal barriers, final individual-level trajectories, price or transport mechanisms, or direct comparison with pre-2025 waves because the 2025 instrument expanded coverage and concepts. Source-dependence audit 2026-09-30: the companion MODECULT 2025 record uses the same survey wave; overlapping estimates are not independent corroboration.
